title: Chasoń: Supporting Cross HBM Channel Data Migration to Enable Efficient Sparse Algebraic Acceleration
authors: Ubaid Bakhtiar, Amirmahdi Namjoo, Bahar Asgari
summary: An HBM-based streaming accelerator for sparse matrix-vector multiplication that migrates data across HBM channels (Cross-HBM Channel out-of-order scheduling) to mitigate resource underutilization.

title: Misam: Machine Learning Assisted Dataflow Selection in Accelerators for Sparse Matrix Multiplication
authors: Sanjali Yadav, Amirmahdi Namjoo, Bahar Asgari
summary: A machine-learning framework that uses a lightweight decision tree and FPGA reconfiguration to select the optimal dataflow for sparse matrix-matrix multiplication at runtime.

title: Belenos: Bottleneck Evaluation to Link Biomechanics to Novel Computing Optimizations
authors: Hana Chitsaz, Johnson Umeike, Amirmahdi Namjoo, Babak N. Safa, Bahar Asgari
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Workload Characterization (IISWC)
summary: A workload characterization of finite-element biomechanics simulations (FEBio) using gem5 and VTune, identifying architectural bottlenecks and optimal configurations for domain-specific accelerators.

title: Novel Distance-Learning Methods to Overcome Challenges Caused by COVID-19 in Undergraduate Programming Courses
authors: Amirmahdi Namjoo, Seyed Parsa Neshaei, Parham Chavoshian, Parham Saremi, Mohammad Taha Jahani-Nezhad, AmirMahdi Kousheshi, Mohammadamin Fazli
venue: 14th International Conference on Education and New Learning Technologies (EDULEARN)
summary: Distance-learning techniques used to improve the education and assessment of undergraduate programming courses at Sharif University of Technology during the COVID-19 pandemic.
